items.what: Stabilise (Planning/Routing.lua:330-340) repeats Recommit's partition (Planning/Routing.lua:303-310): call Ranks(route, rank), split the route into the steps the committed order holds and the fresh ones, sort the held ones by rank. items.quote:
Overview.HubLine = HubLine
Overview.DropLine = DropLine
Overview.Progress = Progress
items.what: Overview hands out the pieces of a card's third line and footer (DropLine, HubLine, Progress, Stops) and each caller reassembles them in the same order: UI/Panel.lua:792 and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:248 for a whole card, UI/Panel.lua:1054-1057 and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:269-273 for a compact or grid card.
items.why: rg 'DropLine\(|HubLine\(' returns the two pairs: `DropLine(journey) or journey.reason or HubLine(journey) or ""` verbatim in Panel.lua:792 and WindowJourneys.lua:248, and the four-step sequence `value, label = Progress(journey)`; `foot = label or Stops(journey)`; `reason = journey.reason ~= foot and journey.reason or nil`; `DropLine(journey) or reason or HubLine(journey) or journey.subline` in Panel.lua:1054-1057 and WindowJourneys.lua:269-273. CardTooltip (Overview.lua:394-400) then has to guess which of those lines the card showed (`card.detail == hub`, `card.state == "compact"`). The precedence rule (log-full note, then reason, then hub, then subline) is the thing Overview's header says panel and window must never disagree on, and it lives in the callers; the reason line and the footer/progress pair would move behind Overview.
items.reason: The shallow-modules exclusion for a caller needing the pieces apart applies: UI/WindowJourneys.lua:254-263 uses Progress independently for the featured footer, hiding it without progress, while grid cards fall back to Stops. Overview.CardTooltip also uses HubLine independently, so the exported pieces serve varying compositions despite the repeated detail precedence.

items.quote: card.detail = DropLine(journey) or reason or HubLine(journey) or journey.subline
items.what: The overview card's reason and footer rule is written twice: UI/Panel.lua:827-830 (RefreshOverviewCard) and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:249-252 (RefreshGrid). The chosen card's rule is also twice: UI/Panel.lua:652 and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:227. Canonical home: UI/Overview.lua, whose header says it holds 'a card's lines and progress' for both views, beside HubLine, DropLine, Progress and Stops.
items.why: Both copies compute foot = label or Stops(journey), drop a reason equal to the foot, then pick DropLine, reason, HubLine, subline in that order; a change to the precedence or the foot rule must land in both files or the map panel and the window disagree on the same journey. Differences: Panel stores the result in card.detail, which Overview.CardTooltip reads (Overview.lua:399-403), while the window's cards never set detail, so the tooltip already branches differently per view: accidental drift. Layout around it (bar room, anchors) differs intentionally and stays with each view.
items.reason: The overview card's reason and footer rule is written at UI/Panel.lua:827-830 and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:249-252, and the chosen card's at UI/Panel.lua:652 and UI/WindowJourneys.lua:227. Move both into UI/Overview.lua, whose header says the two views never disagree? It is a new name there.
